tests.name: Reauthenticate the scheduler operator after server restart
Reauthenticate the ordinary order owner after server restart
Verify the skipped occurrence and active next recurrence survived restart

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN b.enabled AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bank_order_occurrences o WHERE o.bank_orders_id=b.bank_orders_id AND o.outcome='skipped_insufficient_funds')=1 AND (SELECT balance FROM bank_accounts WHERE owner_type='player' AND owner_id=b.player_id AND currency='CRD' AND is_active=TRUE)=0 AND b.next_run_at>b.last_occurrence_at THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM b.next_run_at)::bigint FROM bank_orders b WHERE b.player_id=(SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name='bank_skip_qa');

tests.name: Order owner can still list the active recurring instruction
Fund account through ordinary player workflow for the next scheduled occurrence
Schedule the real bank handler at the next recurrence

data.sql: UPDATE cron_tasks SET enabled=(name='bank_standing_orders_tick'),next_due_at=CASE WHEN name='bank_standing_orders_tick' THEN to_timestamp(@{bank_skip_next_due}) ELSE next_due_at END;

tests.name: Advance the actual registered scheduler to the next recurrence
Verify next occurrence pays once and leaves the instruction active

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN b.enabled AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bank_order_occurrences o WHERE o.bank_orders_id=b.bank_orders_id AND o.outcome='skipped_insufficient_funds')=1 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bank_order_occurrences o WHERE o.bank_orders_id=b.bank_orders_id AND o.outcome='paid' AND o.amount=25)=1 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bank_transactions WHERE tx_group_id LIKE 'bank-order-'||b.bank_orders_id||'-%' AND amount=25)=2 AND (SELECT balance FROM bank_accounts WHERE owner_type='player' AND owner_id=b.player_id AND currency='CRD' AND is_active=TRUE)=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM bank_orders b WHERE b.player_id=(SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name='bank_skip_qa');
